title: Identification of Key Transcription Factors Related to Bacterial Spot Resistance in Pepper through Regulatory Network Analyses.
authors: Zhu, Qingquan; Gao, Shenghua; Zhang, Wenli
one_liner_zh: 通过转录组和共表达网络分析鉴定辣椒抗细菌性斑点病的关键转录因子，但仅基于表达数据，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Bacterial spot (BS), caused by Xanthomonas campestris pv. Vesicatoria (Xcv), severely affects the quality and yield of pepper. Thus, breeding new pepper cultivars with enhanced resistance to BS can improve economic benefits for pepper production. Identification of BS resistance genes is an essential step to achieve this goal. However, very few BS resistance genes have been well characterized in pepper so far. In this study, we reanalyzed public multiple time points related to RNA-seq data sets from two pepper cultivars, the Xcv-susceptible cultivar ECW and the Xcv-resistant cultivar VI037601, post Xcv infection. We identified a total of 3568 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between two cultivars post Xcv infection, which were mainly involved in some biological processes, such as Gene Ontology (GO) terms related to defense response to bacterium, immune system process, and regulation of defense response, etc. Through weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), we identified 15 hub (Hub) transcription factor (TF) candidates in response to Xcv infection. We further selected 20 TFs from the gene regulatory network (GRN) potentially involved in Xcv resistance response. Finally, we predicted 4 TFs, C3H (p-coumarate 3-hydroxylase), ERF (ethylene-responsive element binding factor), TALE (three-amino-acid-loop-extension), and HSF (heat shock transcription factor), as key factors responsible for BS disease resistance in pepper. In conclusion, our study provides valuable resources for dissecting the underlying molecular mechanism responsible for Xcv resistance in pepper. Additionally, it also provides valuable references for mining transcriptomic data to identify key candidates for disease resistance in horticulture crops.
abstract_zh: 细菌性斑点病（BS）由野油菜黄单胞菌辣椒斑点病致病变种（Xanthomonas campestris pv. Vesicatoria, Xcv）引起，严重影响辣椒的品质和产量。因此，培育具有增强BS抗性的新辣椒品种可提高辣椒生产的经济效益。鉴定BS抗性基因是实现这一目标的关键步骤。然而，迄今为止，辣椒中已充分表征的BS抗性基因非常少。在本研究中，我们重新分析了两个辣椒品种（Xcv感病品种ECW和Xcv抗病品种VI037601）在Xcv感染后多个时间点的公共RNA-seq数据集。我们在两个品种间共鉴定出3568个差异表达基因（DEGs），这些基因主要涉及一些生物过程，如与细菌防御反应、免疫系统过程和防御反应调控等相关的基因本体论（GO）条目。通过加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），我们鉴定出15个响应Xcv感染的枢纽（Hub）转录因子（TF）候选基因。我们进一步从基因调控网络（GRN）中筛选出20个可能参与Xcv抗性反应的转录因子。最终，我们预测了4个转录因子，即C3H（对香豆酸3-羟化酶）、ERF（乙烯响应元件结合因子）、TALE（三氨基酸环延伸）和HSF（热激转录因子），作为辣椒BS抗病性的关键因子。总之，我们的研究为解析辣椒Xcv抗性的潜在分子机制提供了宝贵资源。此外，它也为挖掘转录组数据以鉴定园艺作物抗病性关键候选基因提供了有价值的参考。
